title: Do Boat Tours in Madeira Include Hotel Pickup?
description: It depends on the operator. Chifbay's private trips have no pickup: you meet the skipper at Marina do Funchal, a walk, taxi or bus ride from most hotels.
heroAlt: View from Santa Catarina park over palm trees to Funchal harbour, the marina and a cruise ship
keywords: do boat tours in Madeira include hotel pickup
how to get to Marina do Funchal from my hotel

images.prompt: Morning in Parque de Santa Catarina in Funchal, Madeira, looking down over palm trees and flower beds to the harbour: the small white boats of Marina do Funchal on the left, a large white cruise ship berthed along the long Pontinha breakwater on the right, the deep blue Atlantic beyond under a clear sky. In the foreground, a couple seen from behind, small, walk down a park path towards the seafront, one carrying a small backpack. Bright light, realistic, true colours, no text, no logos.
